fieldMarks: Bony armour of rectangular or pentagonal plates in three sections; usually 9 bands, range 8-11
About 0.75 m body plus 0.3 m tail; 3.6-7.7 kg
behavior: Mainly nocturnal or crepuscular; forages earlier on cold or cloudy days
Solitary except when mating; does not hibernate
Digs burrows up to 5 m long, up to 12 dens
Over 90% of diet is animal matter (beetles, termites, ants) found by smell
habitat: Forest and scrub-brush with adequate water and at least 38 cm annual rainfall.
range: South and Central America into the southern US, expanding north since the 1800s to Missouri and Illinois.
